_comment: Country-keyed registry: WHICH local body holds land/water power. A country absent here is NOT harvested - silence beats guessing. desc must contain {unit}. Every emitted URL is fetched and status-checked; unthemed pages (bare council homepages) are logged as gaps, not emitted.

municipal.desc: WHAT IT DOES: {unit} is a Gemeinde, the lowest official level of territorial division in Germany and the tier that holds the Bauleitplanung power - it writes the Flaechennutzungsplan and Bebauungsplan that decide what may be built where. USE IT: draft plans go to public participation (Oeffentlichkeitsbeteiligung) with a statutory objection window; the linked page is the council's own planning or environment section.

WHAT IT DOES: {unit} is a commune, the tier that adopts the plan local d'urbanisme (PLU) and issues most permis de construire - the decisions that determine whether a site can be built on at all. USE IT: PLU revisions carry a mandatory enquete publique with a commissaire enqueteur who must answer objections on the record; the linked page is the commune's urbanisme or environnement section.
